title: Cyber Law Jurisdictional Map
description: Statutes grouped into U.S. Federal, U.S. State, and International bands. Hover any law for its scope, who it regulates, its key obligation, and its breach-notification window; pick a scenario to highlight the laws that apply and read why.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Societal Security: Law, Forensics, and Ethics
learningObjectives: Identify which cyber and privacy laws apply to a given data-handling scenario.
Explain why a law's jurisdiction reaches a particular scenario (data subject, data location, or regulated entity).
Compare breach-notification windows across federal, state, and international regimes.
educational.prerequisites: General awareness that privacy and cybercrime laws exist; no legal background required.

pedagogical.interaction: Hover statute cards for details; scenario dropdown highlights applicable laws and explains each in a side panel.
pedagogical.assessment: Lesson plan asks students to predict applicable laws before selecting a scenario.
pedagogical.misconceptions: Counters the idea that location alone decides jurisdiction by showing data-subject and entity-based reach (e.g., GDPR).
